name: Mailchimp Events
description: Creates events for Mailchimp's Behavioral Targeting.
project_description:
This is an enhancement to the Mailchimp integration module which allows you to utilize Behavioral Targeting .

 This module was part of the Mailchimp project for many years, but its functionality is specific enough that it has been separated out into its own project. It is still dependent on the Mailchimp module, and was created as an exact copy of the code from that module.

 Features 
 Using this module, you can track interactions on your Drupal site from known users (either logged in, or otherwise sharing an email address) into Mailchimp, and use that information when building audiences in Mailchimp. Is someone commenting on all your Spaghetti-related content? Make sure they get your pasta-focused newsletter!

 Post-Installation 
 Check out the Readme and visit Mailchimp's documentation about behavioral targeting.

 Additional Requirements 
 This project is 100% dependent on the Mailchimp module. You must install and configure the Mailchimp module before this module will do anything.
